_readme: Copy to ~/.inbox-triage/config.json and fill it in. Every field is explained in SETUP.md.

run._how: Used by scripts/run_headless.py (OS scheduler). In the Claude app, pick the model and effort in the session before starting; app scheduled tasks cannot pin a model. See SETUP.md step 4.

_counsel_note: Optional: email addresses or @domains of your attorneys or advisors. Unanswered replies from them resurface daily. Law-firm domains and names ending in Esq. are detected automatically.

notify._channel_options: none (digest.txt only) | sms | telegram (only if you have a texting tool connected)

voice.tone: warm, short, plain words, no exclamation stacks
voice.nudge_template: Hi {first_name}, wanted to bump this up in case it got buried. {one_line_ask} No rush if you need a few more days.

send_rules._auto_send_note: Leave false. The skill only drafts. Change only if you write your own rule list below and sign off on it.
